run_catch_grpc_server: run the CatchEnvironmentService gRPC server to serve a Catch game environment over dm_env_rpc
create_catch_game: create a CatchGame instance with specified rows, columns, and a random seed for the ball position
step_catch_environment: step the Catch game environment by sending a paddle action via the gRPC step message
reset_catch_world: reset the Catch game world with an optional seed setting via the gRPC reset message
join_catch_world: join the Catch game world and receive action and observation specs via the gRPC join message
